mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tight monetary conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a low UNRATE (below 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of periods with UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth exceeds 1% and HOUST increases by more than 1,000 units, the combined signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in post-shock recovery regimes, a RSAFS increase of more than $10,000 signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of post-shock recovery periods with RSAFS increase > $10,000.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high CPIAUCSL (above 200) signals inflation concerns, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a PAYEMS increase of more than 200,000 signals labor market strength, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 45% of periods with PAYEMS increase > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit month-over-month growth, the combined signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit MoM growth
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
